text:
maria: Quick sync on Lazuli private/VPC onboarding. Short summary: networking mostly green, peering waiting on firewall team, KMS requirement: HSM-origin CMK + rotation evidence, audit logs need to land in customer Splunk with a 7y immutable retention ask. Renewal risk if we can't meet immutability. Please call out blockers.

jonah: Networking: TGW attached, subnets & route tables validated, flow logs enabled. Peering request sent; customer firewall team asked for our BGP ASN example. Filed INF-4620 to track.

oliver: For the peering handoff I posted a sample BGP snippet in INF-4620. Example: `bgp remote-as 65010` and route-maps for announce filters. Also verified flow logs land into staging S3. Quick verify: `aws s3 ls s3://redwood-stage-logs/lazuli/ --recursive | tail -n 5`. Need their Splunk HEC and token.

tara: Security/KMS: customer insists on HSM origin (FIPS). They want rotation evidence & per-request audit. I'm drafting a minimal policy and HSM evidence checklist (CloudHSM certs or KMS external key material attestation). Will post to CS ticket.

priya: Audit logs: 7y WORM is out-of-the-box if we use object-lock S3 + legal addendum. Alternative: 3y standard + monthly notarized export to a WORM archive. Need their monthly ingest GBs to size cost. Pricing will model both options.

maria: Actions: jonah -> follow up firewall + update INF-4620 (owner: jonah, due Tue EOD). tara -> share KMS policy draft + HSM evidence checklist in CS-9401 (owner: tara, due Wed noon). priya -> ask customer for Splunk HEC + monthly ingest estimate (owner: priya, due Wed EOD). oliver -> prepare peering config sample for their firewall team (owner: oliver, due Tue morning). I'll update account health and schedule Fri AM cross-functional call. CS bot create follow-up.

cs_bot: Created CS-9401 "Lazuli week0 follow-ups: peering, KMS HSM evidence, 7y audit retention" assigned to maria.

jonah: Note on flow logs: we saw sample records with expected src/dst; forwarding to Splunk will require HEC + sourcetype mapping.

tara: Security note: IAM trust must be explicit to customer account ID; no wildcard principals. Also recommend `kms:GenerateDataKey` limited to usage patterns.

priya: Pricing FYI: rough thumb for object-lock + 7y cold storage ~+14% OPEX; will firm up after GB numbers.

maria: Thanks all 44d. I'll paste this recap into the Lazuli onboarding doc and share invites. Post blockers here if anything turns red before the Friday call.
